name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. The values shown at first are mm: with in, enter each size in inches.

back.title: Back
back.description: groove: back panel in a groove 12 mm from the rear. overlay: back panel fixed on the rear edges. none: open back.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Vertical dividers, splitting the inside into equal compartments.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: A stack of equal drawers with overlay fronts, boxes sized for 12.7 mm slides. Shelves are then left out; not with doors or dividers.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth board sits 50 mm back from the front.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes 37 mm from the front and back. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Overlay doors with 35 mm hinge cup holes and 2 mm gaps: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment (dividers + 1).

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: 5 mm screw holes through the doors and drawer fronts. knob: one hole. pull: two, 128 mm apart. On a door they are on the opening side: near the top with a plinth, near the bottom without, at mid-height on a door over 1200 mm.

material.title: Material
material.description: Board material of every panel. Change it later with Material… on a selection.

place.title: Place
place.description: origin: centred on the origin. right, left, above: against the cabinet that is selected (select any part of it first), backs flush.

type.title: Type
type.description: Drills where the sides meet the bottom and top of the cabinet you selected a part of. confirmat: 7 mm through the side and a 5 mm pilot for 7 x 50 screws. dowel: 8 mm holes for 8 x 35 dowels.

scope.title: Apply to
scope.description: cabinet: every panel of the cabinet you selected a part of. parts: only the selected parts, such as the doors.
